name.zh: 瓦拉内（加迪加尔人之地）

polity.zh: 伊奥拉族加迪加尔氏族

polity.en: New South Wales, Commonwealth of Australia
polity.zh: 澳大利亚联邦新南威尔士州

summary.en: Warrane is the Eora name for the cove where the First Fleet landed in January 1788; Phillip named it Sydney Cove after the Home Secretary, Lord Sydney. The settlement, incorporated as the City of Sydney in 1842, grew into Australia's largest city.
summary.zh: 瓦拉内是伊奥拉人对1788年1月第一舰队登陆之湾的称呼；菲利普以内政大臣悉尼勋爵之名将其命名为悉尼湾。这一定居点于1842年设为悉尼市，后发展为澳大利亚最大城市。

note: The Aboriginal start date marks only the atlas's first year; Eora occupation of the harbour is many thousands of years older.

polity.en: Wurundjeri and Bunurong peoples of the Kulin nation
polity.zh: 库林族的乌伦杰里人与布努荣人

name.zh: 贝尔布拉斯 / 巴特曼尼亚

polity.en: Unauthorised settlement claimed by New South Wales
polity.zh: 新南威尔士声索下的非法定居点

polity.en: Port Phillip District, New South Wales
polity.zh: 新南威尔士菲利普港区
澳大利亚联邦（政府所在地）
澳大利亚联邦维多利亚州

summary.en: Founded in 1835 by John Batman's and John Pascoe Fawkner's parties on Kulin land around Naarm (Port Phillip). Early names included Bearbrass and Batmania until Governor Bourke named it Melbourne in 1837. Gold made it Australia's richest city, and it was the federal seat of government until 1927.
summary.zh: 1835年，约翰·巴特曼和约翰·帕斯科·福克纳的队伍在纳姆（菲利普港）一带的库林人土地上建立定居点。早期名称有贝尔布拉斯、巴特曼尼亚等，1837年总督伯克将其定名为墨尔本。黄金使其成为澳大利亚最富庶的城市，1927年前一直是联邦政府所在地。

sources.title: eMelbourne (University of Melbourne): Names of Melbourne

note: Naarm is widely used today for the Melbourne area and Port Phillip Bay; Kulin occupation far predates the atlas start year.

polity.en: Tāmaki iwi (Waiohua, later Ngāti Whātua Ōrākei)
polity.zh: 塔玛基诸部落（怀奥胡阿，后为恩加蒂瓦图阿·奥拉凯）

name.zh: 奥克兰 / 塔玛基马卡瑙劳

summary.en: Tāmaki Makaurau, 'Tāmaki desired by many', was a densely settled isthmus of volcanic-cone pā. Ngāti Whātua Ōrākei offered land to Governor Hobson, who founded Auckland in September 1840 and made it capital in 1841. The capital moved to Wellington in 1865.
summary.zh: 塔玛基马卡瑙劳意为“众人所向往的塔玛基”，是一片火山锥上遍布堡寨的人口稠密地峡。恩加蒂瓦图阿·奥拉凯部落向霍布森总督提供土地，霍布森于1840年9月建立奥克兰，1841年定为首都。1865年首都迁往惠灵顿。

sources.title: Te Ara / Encyclopedia of New Zealand: Auckland places

polity.en: Ngāi Tara and Ngāti Ira, later Te Āti Awa (from the 1820s)
polity.zh: 恩加伊塔拉与恩加蒂伊拉，19世纪20年代起为特阿蒂阿瓦

name.zh: 尼科尔森港 / 不列颠尼亚
惠灵顿 / 特方加努伊阿塔拉

summary.en: The great harbour of Tara, son of the explorer Whātonga in tradition, was bought dubiously by the New Zealand Company in 1839. Settlers first landed at Petone ('Britannia') in 1840 before moving to Lambton Harbour, renamed Wellington after the Duke. It became capital in 1865 for its central position.
summary.zh: 传说中这座大港以探险者瓦通加之子塔拉命名，1839年新西兰公司以颇具争议的方式“购得”。1840年移民先在佩托内（“不列颠尼亚”）登陆，随后迁至兰姆顿港，并以威灵顿公爵之名改称惠灵顿。因地处中部，1865年成为首都。

sources.title: Te Ara / Encyclopedia of New Zealand: Wellington region – Māori history

polity.zh: 临时政府 / 夏威夷共和国

summary.en: Kou was the old name of the district around the sheltered harbour later called Honolulu, 'sheltered bay'. Its deep harbour drew sandalwood and whaling ships; Kamehameha III moved the royal capital here from Lahaina in 1845. Chinese migrants called it Tánxiāngshān, 'Sandalwood Mountain'.
summary.zh: 科乌是这一避风港周边地区的旧称，港湾后来称为火奴鲁鲁，意为“避风之湾”。深水良港吸引了檀香木商船和捕鲸船；1845年卡美哈梅哈三世把王都从拉海纳迁至此。华人移民称之为“檀香山”。

sources.title: M. K. Pukui, S. H. Elbert & E. T. Mookini, Place Names of Hawaii (University of Hawaii Press, 1974)

note: The date range for Kou is an approximation for pre-contact Oʻahu.

polity.en: Republic, then US Territory of Hawaii
polity.zh: 夏威夷共和国，后为美国夏威夷领地

summary.en: Known anciently as Lele, the west Maui town was a seat of Maui chiefs and, from about 1820 to 1845, the royal capital of the Kingdom of Hawaiʻi, a whaling port and the site of Lahainaluna, the first school west of the Rockies to print books. Most of the historic town burned in the wildfire of 8 August 2023.
summary.zh: 西毛伊岛的这座城镇古称莱莱，是毛伊酋长驻地；约1820至1845年为夏威夷王国王都，也是捕鲸港，拉海纳卢纳学校是落基山以西最早印刷书籍的学校。2023年8月8日的山火烧毁了老城大部分。

sources.title: National Park Service: Lahaina Historic District
M. K. Pukui, S. H. Elbert & E. T. Mookini, Place Names of Hawaii (University of Hawaii Press, 1974)

note: The capital years are approximate: the court resided at Lahaina from the early 1820s until Kamehameha III moved to Honolulu in 1845.

polity.en: Kingdom of Tahiti under French protectorate
polity.zh: 法国保护下的塔希提王国

summary.en: The name, 'water basket', recalls the springs where water was drawn. Papeʻete's harbour drew missionaries and traders; Queen Pōmare IV made it her seat, and after 1842 it became the French administrative capital of the islands.
summary.zh: 其名意为“水篮”，源于人们汲水的泉眼。帕皮提港吸引了传教士和商人；波马雷四世女王以此为驻地，1842年后成为法国在群岛的行政首府。

sources.title: C. Newbury, Tahiti Nui (University of Hawaii Press, 1980)

note: The pre-contact range is approximate; the town grew mainly after the 1820s.

polity.zh: 法属新喀里多尼亚殖民地
法属新喀里多尼亚殖民地

polity.en: New Caledonia (French overseas territory, then sui generis collectivity)
polity.zh: 新喀里多尼亚（法国海外领地，后为特殊集体）

summary.en: Founded on Kanak land in 1854 as the military post Port-de-France, it was renamed Nouméa in 1866 to avoid confusion with Fort-de-France in Martinique. It served the penal colony from 1864 and the nickel industry, and hosted the US South Pacific command in the Second World War.
summary.zh: 1854年在卡纳克人土地上作为军事据点“法兰西港”建立，1866年为避免与马提尼克的法兰西堡混淆而改名努美阿。自1864年起服务于流放殖民地和镍矿业，二战中是美军南太平洋司令部所在地。

polity.zh: 洛迈维蒂诸酋邦（莱武卡酋长）

summary.en: A beachcomber and whaling port on Ovalau from the 1830s, Levuka became the capital of Cakobau's kingdom and of the British colony, where the Deed of Cession was signed in 1874. The capital moved to Suva in 1882. UNESCO listed the Historical Port Town of Levuka in 2013.
summary.zh: 莱武卡自19世纪30年代起是奥瓦劳岛上的海滩流浪者和捕鲸者港口，后成为卡科鲍王国和英国殖民地的首都，1874年《割让契约》在此签署。1882年首都迁往苏瓦。2013年“莱武卡历史港口城镇”列入联合国教科文组织世界遗产。

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Levuka Historical Port Town

note: The start of the Fijian village is approximate.

polity.zh: 萨摩亚酋长政体（图阿马萨加区）

polity.en: Western Samoa under New Zealand (occupation, mandate, trust territory)
polity.zh: 新西兰治下的西萨摩亚（占领、委任统治、托管）

summary.en: A village on Upolu that grew into a trading town where British, American and German consuls intrigued among rival Samoan chiefs; a hurricane wrecked their warships in the harbour in 1889. It was the capital of German Samoa, of New Zealand's mandate and, from 1962, of independent Samoa.
summary.zh: 乌波卢岛上的一个村落，后发展为贸易城镇，英、美、德三国领事在此卷入萨摩亚敌对酋长之间的角逐；1889年飓风摧毁了停泊港内的各国军舰。它先后是德属萨摩亚、新西兰委任统治地的首府，1962年起为独立的萨摩亚首都。

sources.title: M. Meleisea, Lagaga: A Short History of Western Samoa (USP, 1987)

modern.zh: 芒阿雷瓦岛（甘比尔群岛）

name.zh: 芒阿雷瓦 / 甘比尔群岛

polity.zh: 芒阿雷瓦王国（1834年起有天主教传教团）

polity.en: French Establishments in Oceania, then French Polynesia
polity.zh: 法属大洋洲殖民地，后为法属波利尼西亚

summary.en: Around 1000–1450 Mangareva was the hub of a voyaging network that carried basalt, pearl shell and volcanic glass to Pitcairn and Henderson islands. James Wilson of the missionary ship Duff named the group after Admiral Gambier in 1797. Catholic missionaries under Honoré Laval built a stone cathedral at Rikitea in the 1840s.
summary.zh: 约1000至1450年间，芒阿雷瓦是一个航海网络的中心，玄武岩、珍珠贝和火山玻璃由此运往皮特凯恩岛和亨德森岛。1797年传教船“达夫号”的詹姆斯·威尔逊以甘比尔海军上将之名命名该群岛。19世纪40年代，奥诺雷·拉瓦尔率领的天主教传教士在里基泰阿建起石砌大教堂。

sources.title: M. I. Weisler, 'Henderson Island prehistory: colonization and extinction on a remote Polynesian island', Biological Journal of the Linnean Society 56 (1995)

note: Settlement date is approximate (c. 1000 CE or slightly earlier).

name.en: Te Pito o te Henua (traditional) / Rapa Nui
name.zh: 特皮托奥特赫努阿（传统称呼）/ 拉帕努伊

polity.en: Rapa Nui chiefdoms under the Miru ariki mau
polity.zh: 米鲁世系最高酋长统领下的拉帕努伊诸部

name.zh: 复活节岛 / 拉帕努伊
复活节岛 / 拉帕努伊

summary.en: Polynesians settled the island around 1200. Roggeveen named it Paasch-Eyland on Easter Sunday 1722; a Spanish expedition claimed it as San Carlos in 1770. Peruvian slave raids and smallpox in 1862–63 nearly destroyed the population; Chile annexed the island in 1888.
summary.zh: 波利尼西亚人约在1200年定居该岛。1722年复活节，罗赫芬将其命名为“复活节岛”；1770年西班牙探险队宣称占有，命名为圣卡洛斯岛。1862至1863年秘鲁奴隶贩子的掳掠和天花几乎毁灭了岛上人口；1888年智利吞并该岛。

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Rapa Nui National Park
S. R. Fischer, Island at the End of the World: The Turbulent History of Easter Island (Reaktion, 2005)

note: 'Te Pito o te Henua' may be a 19th-century attribution; 'Rapa Nui' itself seems to have been coined in the 1860s by Polynesian sailors, though it is now the island's accepted name.

polity.en: Van Diemen's Land, part of New South Wales
polity.zh: 新南威尔士治下的范迪门地

polity.en: Colony of Van Diemen's Land (Tasmania from 1856)
polity.zh: 范迪门地殖民地（1856年起称塔斯马尼亚）
澳大利亚联邦塔斯马尼亚州

summary.en: Founded by Lieutenant-Governor David Collins at Sullivans Cove on the Derwent in 1804, on the country of the muwinina people. Hobart Town was a penal and whaling port and the capital of Van Diemen's Land; it was officially renamed Hobart in 1881.
summary.zh: 1804年副总督戴维·柯林斯在德文特河畔沙利文湾建立，这里是穆维尼纳人的故土。霍巴特镇是流放犯与捕鲸港口，也是范迪门地首府；1881年正式更名为霍巴特。

sources.title: Companion to Tasmanian History (University of Tasmania): Hobart

polity.zh: 图尔巴尔人与尤格拉人

name.en: Moreton Bay penal settlement / Brisbane Town
name.zh: 莫顿湾流放地 / 布里斯班镇

polity.en: Colony of New South Wales (free settlement)
polity.zh: 新南威尔士殖民地（自由定居）
澳大利亚联邦昆士兰州

summary.en: A harsh penal settlement for re-offending convicts was moved to the Brisbane River in 1825, on Turrbal and Yuggera land called Meanjin; for a time it was proposed to call it Edenglassie. Opened to free settlers in 1842, Brisbane became the capital of the new colony of Queensland in 1859.
summary.zh: 1825年，一座关押再犯罪犯的严酷流放地迁至布里斯班河畔，这里是图尔巴尔人和尤格拉人称为米安金的土地；一度有人提议称之为“伊登格拉西”。1842年向自由移民开放，1859年成为新建的昆士兰殖民地首府。

name.zh: 古卢莫尔金（拉拉基亚人之地）

summary.en: Surveyor George Goyder founded Palmerston on Larrakia land in 1869 beside the harbour named Port Darwin by HMS Beagle's crew in 1839. Renamed Darwin when the Commonwealth took over the Territory in 1911, it was bombed in 1942 and destroyed by Cyclone Tracy in 1974.
summary.zh: 1869年，测量师乔治·戈伊德在拉拉基亚人土地上建立帕默斯顿镇，旁边的港湾在1839年由“小猎犬号”船员命名为达尔文港。1911年联邦接管北领地后改称达尔文，1942年遭轰炸，1974年被特雷西气旋摧毁。

note: Spellings of the Larrakia name vary (Gulumoerrgin, Garramilla is also used for the city area).

name.zh: 努纳瓦尔人与恩甘布里人之地

polity.zh: 努纳瓦尔人与恩甘布里人

name.zh: 坎伯里 / 堪培拉（牧区）

polity.en: Colony, then State, of New South Wales
polity.zh: 新南威尔士殖民地，后为州
联邦首都领地（首都在建）

summary.en: The name comes from Joshua Moore's 1820s 'Canberry' station, probably from a local Aboriginal word. Chosen as a compromise between Sydney and Melbourne, the planned capital of Walter Burley Griffin and Marion Mahony Griffin was named by Lady Denman in 1913; Parliament opened there in 1927.
summary.zh: 地名源于约书亚·穆尔19世纪20年代的“坎伯里”牧场，可能来自当地原住民词语。作为悉尼与墨尔本之间的折中之选，这座由沃尔特·伯利·格里芬和玛丽昂·马奥尼·格里芬规划的首都于1913年由登曼夫人命名，1927年议会迁入。

sources.title: National Archives of Australia: Naming Canberra

note: The derivation of 'Canberra' is debated; 1824 is the year Moore took up the station.

summary.en: Kororāreka, 'sweet penguin', was the rowdy whaling port of the Bay of Islands. The first capital, named Russell, was at nearby Okiato in 1840–41; in 1844 Governor FitzRoy made Kororāreka part of Russell township. Hōne Heke's forces sacked it in 1845. A 2025 bid to restore the name Kororāreka was declined by the minister.
summary.zh: 科罗拉雷卡意为“甜美的企鹅”，是岛屿湾喧闹的捕鲸港。1840至1841年的首个首都名为拉塞尔，位于附近的奥基亚托；1844年总督菲茨罗伊将科罗拉雷卡划入拉塞尔镇。1845年霍内·赫克的部队洗劫此地。2025年恢复科罗拉雷卡旧名的申请被部长否决。

sources.title: Te Ara / Encyclopedia of New Zealand: Northland places – Russell
RNZ: Proposal to change Russell's name to Kororāreka declined (May 2025)
